title: Preferences
subtitle: Preferences save immediately; quick actions affect this workspace
resetDescription: Restore the default interface style, accent color, layout, menu and general options.

config.importError: Could not import settings. Choose a valid file exported by Ray Template.
config.exportError: Could not export settings. Check your preferences and try again.
config.fileLimit: The settings file must be 256 KiB or smaller.

appearance.displayHint: Show or hide breadcrumbs, page tabs, and the footer together, or adjust each below.
appearance.resetHint: Reset the style, accent, animation, drawer position, and display options. Keep the current color mode.

menu.sizeHint: Presets adjust width, indentation, and icon sizes while keeping menu behavior. Sizes are in px.
menu.collapsedModeHint: Shrink mode narrows the content with the sidebar. Keep-width mode clips content at its original width. Both use the collapsed width.
menu.sidebarHint: Collapse and scroll actions affect the current sidebar without changing the layout mode.
menu.noSidebarHint: This view has no desktop sidebar to control. Size and behavior preferences are kept for when the sidebar is shown.
menu.refreshFailed: Could not refresh the menu. Please try again.

watermark.presetsHint: Only adjusts the style. Keeps the watermark text and fullscreen setting.
watermark.previewHint: The preview stays visible while the fullscreen watermark is off.
watermark.dimensionsHint: Sizes are in px and angles in °. Cell width + horizontal gap and cell height + vertical gap must each be 1–4096 px. Negative gaps allow overlapping.

general.title: Dynamic browser title
general.refreshHint: Reload the current page and release workspace page instances. Unsaved form changes will be lost.
general.cacheLimitHint: Pages are queued by recent access. Set to 0 to stop adding pages; turn caching off to disable it immediately.
general.clearCacheConfirm: Release inactive cached pages. Unsaved changes may be lost. The current page stays open and will be recreated after leaving and returning.
general.cacheCleared: Page cache cleared. The current page stays open.
general.recentCount: This account has {count} recent visits used by the dashboard and global search.
general.clearRecentConfirm: Clear only this account's recent visits. Favorites and open tabs will be kept.
general.historyStorageUnavailable: Browser storage is unavailable. Record changes apply only to this session.
general.resetHint: Restore only the dynamic title and page cache preferences. Keep the interface language, visit history, and other modules unchanged.
general.resetDone: Dynamic title and cache preferences restored to defaults.

layout.presetsHint: Change content width and spacing while keeping navigation and fixed bars.
layout.maximizeHint: Temporarily hide navigation and the footer. Close settings to see the result, then press Esc or use the exit button to restore. This resets on page reload.
